note: D90 (2026-09-28): the public history from 4ce5449 on was rewritten to drop site/node_modules, a symlink committed by mistake whose target named a local path. Each rewritten commit has the same tree, message, author and dates as the original. A run's records keep the commit id they recorded (results/ is evidence); the builder links the rewritten id, which is the same code on GitHub. Ids are abbreviated to 10 characters, as the dataset abbreviates them (a full id can hold a 12-digit run, which the leak check reads as an account id).
